subject: Quick question about the workshop session
text:
Hi there,

I wanted to check in about the classwork from Tuesday. My daughter has been doing the reading on the side, but she got sick this morning and missed the part where you explained the group project. Since this came up so last minute, I wasn't sure whether the rest of the group has already chosen topics.

She can catch up on the reading, and I can help her review the assignment sheet tonight. My only worry is timing. If teams are already locked in, would it be okay for her to join late with a short make-up task, or is there another way for her to complete the same requirement?

I know you had a full schedule, so I appreciate any guidance when you have a moment. Please let me know if there is a form, deadline, or extra step I should send by email. We want to follow the class plan without making things harder for everyone else.

Thanks so much for understanding, and sorry for the quick notice. I hope this isn't too much trouble this week.

Warmly,
A parent volunteer
